messages:
Maya K: Quick heads-up 1: we need a short runbook for SI co-sell when marketplace + hw partner leads arrive. Goal: <2 step routing + clear owner at 48h.
Diego R: agree. volume from AtlasMarket is spiking. what's the minimal metadata we need on intake?
Maya K: minimal: lead_id, account_name, lead_source, partner_name, estimated_arr, region, initial_mql_score, timestamp. add marketplace_listing_id if from a listing.
Brett H: recommend adding 'partner_contract_priority' (boolean) so contract-backed partners override normal claims.
Priya S: +1. also include "intake_confidence" (low/med/high) if partner provided qualification notes. helps prioritize.
Maya K: propose routing rules: 1) If partner_contract_priority=true -> route to partner-op queue and notify partner-rep. 2) Else if ARR >=100k OR mql_score>=70 -> route to SI-team queue. 3) Else route to PL-team for nurture. auto-ack within 24h, claim window 48h.
Diego R: for HW partner referrals, we need to map serial account regions to our sales region mapping. I'll attach mapping in confluence.
partner-ops-bot: New intake template created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partnerships/si-co-sell-runbook (page 912)  webhook ok
Brett H: tie-breaker when both SI and field claim: 1) partner_contract_priority, 2) partner_claim_ts, 3) sku-alignment (if lead tied to hw SKU with partner as reseller), 4) last-resort AE override with mandatory note.
Priya S: add arbitration TTL: if conflict flagged, auto-post summary to #co-sell-escalate with 12h SLA for manual decision, else follow deterministic tie-break.
Maya K: LegalBot, any fuss about auto-assigning to partner-op queue?
LegalBot: No legal blocker for routing metadata. Ensure partners have consented to lead sharing per contract.
Diego R: sample CSV header for intake automation: 
```
lead_id,account_name,lead_source,partner_name,partner_listing_id,estimated_arr,mql_score,region,partner_contract_priority,intake_confidence,timestamp
```
Maya K: ops play: if unclaimed >48h, create 'stale-claim' task in Asana and cc regional SDR. weekly sweep owned by partner-ops.
Brett H: reporting: add tag 'si_routed:true' and 'claimed_by' field. Also include 'claim_history' as comma-separated values for audit.
Priya S: partner-facing messaging: short one-liner + link to claim button. Draft: "Thanks for the lead! To claim co-sell assistance, click Claim and we'll respond within 48 hours. If unclaimed, your lead will be routed back to Redwood sales." I'll drop draft in #partnerships later.
Maya K: next actions: Diego update region->sales mapping (EOD), Brett add reporting columns to ingestion schema (tomorrow), Priya publish partner message draft (by tomorrow AM), I'll wire the Asana automation and update confluence runbook.
Diego R: :thumbsup: mapping update will include SKU->region overrides.
Brett H: :thumbsup: will update schema and create GH PR for ingestion lambda.
Priya S: :thumbsup: posting draft shortly.
Maya K: thanks team. closing note: keep this thread as source-of-truth for the runbook changes. will ping when confluence page updated. :white_check_mark:
